title: Good tech isn’t enough: how to build real operational outcomes
summary: Good technology alone doesn’t guarantee operational outcomes. Explore the connections, coordination and expertise that industrial digitalization requires
body_markdown:
## Belden helps you put the right connections in place


When you work with Belden, we start by learning about your challenge. Our complete connection solutions bring data infrastructure into alignment, from OT to IT and cloud.


When challenges require capabilities beyond networking and data infrastructure, we have an ecosystem of trusted technology providers, software companies, installers, integrators and other specialists that bring complementary capabilities to the work.


One example of this is how we collaborate with[Accenture and NVIDIA](https://www.belden.com/solutions/shopfloor-safety-with-physical-ai) to improve shop floor safety when using physical AI. By combining our industrial networking and connectivity infrastructure with NVIDIA-powered edge AI and simulation technology and Accenture’s integration expertise, manufacturers can detect hazards and trigger responses that protect workers.


Camera and sensor data feed edge applications, while network connections enable alerts and closed-loop actions. Digital twins support simulation and synthetic data generation for model training. This brings these capabilities into an operational solution.


The experts in our[Customer Innovation Centers (CICs)](https://www.belden.com/services/customer-innovation-center) help put approaches like these into practice. We work alongside your team to understand your challenge, engineer the architecture and bring required technologies together. When complementary expertise is needed, our ecosystem partners become part of that solution.


From resilient industrial networks and mobile asset connectivity to edge computing, cybersecurity and data infrastructure, **Belden helps customers build the connections** their digital applications depend on. When the challenge extends beyond what we can provide, we pull together the right ecosystem to complete the picture. Those are the connections that matter.


[Contact the CIC](https://www.belden.com/services/customer-innovation-center)
